chunks: And Dāwūd al-Raqqī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
When you have finished your rites, then return, for that is more conducive to your longing to return.

key_terms.أَشْوَقُ: more likely to produce longing and eagerness
key_terms.فَارْجِعْ: then return; depart after completing the rites
key_terms.نُسُكِكَ: your ritual acts of worship, especially the rites of hajj

ai.seo_question: Why does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instruct the pilgrim to return after completing the hajj rites?
ai.summary: This hadith advises the pilgrim to return after completing the hajj rites rather than lingering unnecessarily. Its meaning is that departing after finishing the nusuk preserves and renews one’s yearning to come back again for worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2340 - It has been narrated by Dawud Al-Raqqi from Abu Abdullah (as) that he said:
"When you have completed your rituals, then return, for it will make you more eager to come back."
